channel.title: POLITICO Influence
channel.description: Delivered daily, Influence gives you a comprehensive rundown and analysis of all lobby hires and news on K Street.

item.title: Means ignites a K Street battle over corruption allegations
item.description: One of Washington’s top lobbyists has landed in the crosshairs of a MAHA activist’s allegations about K Street’s influence on the Trump administration.
